title: Recorder: nothing to change mid-take
change: While recording, the layout tiles and the devices control are hidden. Only Stop with the timer and Pause remain, in the place the record button had. The answer to Who is this for? stays above the preview as the on-screen prompt.
evidence: 19 controls stayed clickable mid-take, including four layouts and two device pickers. A take has one layout.
notes: The before had the camera menu left open from an earlier click and a Change screen button; the after shows a clean camera-only take, where Change screen never appears. Stop stays at the bottom so the cursor that pressed Record is already on it.
